title: Live bios run on Jev and results
description:
## Purpose

Run the approved bios plan live on Jev and publish the result.

## Scope

Labeler comments, rounds 1-3, final through reloaded bundles, optional D, write-up. Each stage has its own new ledger file and gate caps.

## Definition of done

Results published and the decision rules answered.

## Cost cap

Cumulative Jev ceiling 15,000 requests (about $6-9) across all stages; about 300 gpt-6-luna calls. Anything above needs new owner approval.

## Links

[DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md); [UNIFIED_FLYWHEEL_RESULTS.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/UNIFIED_FLYWHEEL_RESULTS.md)
